notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited only after saving, not before.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate saves are prevented and the existing item can be shown, but the flow does not enter or explicitly direct the user into editing it.
REF-BM-07: Items expose title, description, and tags, but use a generated hostname initial rather than the collected favicon.
REF-BM-11: Tag chips cannot be selected to filter the library; tag filtering requires manually entering #tag in search.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, note, and hostname, but omits the URL path and query string.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parentheses work only with uppercase operators; unquoted lowercase operators are treated as literal terms despite the specified example and quoting rule.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support.
REF-BM-29: No reusable saved-filter bundles.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export.
REF-BM-32: No persistent personal display settings such as default sort, displayed items, or font size.
